title: Lena and the Parish
author: Vesper Fairweather
blurb: Sebastian Galloway, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
